text:
Location: Ton Son Nhut
Right next to Hooch. The hooch in background is the neighbors hooch. My hooch is to the left just out of the shot. I'm holding a fully automatic Thompson .45 caliber machine gun. It was mine and I got it from Gagne. He was in charge of all the weapons at Ton Son Nhut
researchNotes: 'In charge of all the weapons at Ton Son Nhut' differs from his earlier placement of Gagne at the Special Forces armory on Núi Bà Đen (data/people/gagne.json, VN-0082/VN-0084). Both kept, not reconciled.
